title: BMR-M-02 slippage fix verified: proportional BPT exit now uses correct non-zero per-leg floors
description: Baseline passed minAmountsOut=[0,0] to removeLiquidityProportional (unbounded exit). The fix computes minAmountsOut[i] = (balancesRaw[i]*bptSlice/totalSupply) * (10000-50)/10000 from live Vault reserves (getPoolTokenInfo), with require(minAmountsOut[i] > 0). Fork-verified at block 25208568: token order [sUSDS, phUSD] is consistent between getPoolTokenInfo and amountsOut; denominator totalSupply() is correct (getActualSupply reverts on this pool and the computed expectedOut matched the actual released sUSDS leg to the wei); sUSDS leg released 46.0 vs floor 45.77 (0.5% headroom); both pool tokens are STANDARD with no rate provider so there is no rate-drift gap. The zero-floor brick require is unreachable at realistic reserves.
impact: Fixed. The proportional exit is now bounded; no sandwich/MEV exposure on the cutover seed.
evidence: side-effects.json fixVerification.fixA_slippage_BMR-M-02; preview run + forge test AuditBatchMinterReplace.
recommendation: No further action for this entry point. (Optional) the leg-matching loop silently ignores any token that is neither SUSDS nor PHUSD; the require(rawToks.length==2) guard makes that safe today.
dedupDisposition: PRESERVED (reconciliation record; not a new finding to report — ledger must record fixed status)

title: BMR-M-01 incomplete-migration fix verified: SYA.nudgeSplit restored to 30, claim() now funds the new minter
description: Baseline repointed SYA.nudge and POOLER.batchMinter but left SYA.nudgeSplit at the incident-zeroed 0, so the repointed pot was never funded by SYA.claim(). The fix adds setNudgeSplit(30) after setNudgeAddress (correct order: SYA.claim reverts NudgeNotConfigured if split>0 && nudge==0) with post-condition require(nudgeSplit()==30). Fork-verified at block 25208568: after the script alone, SYA.nudge==newMinter and SYA.nudgeSplit==30; ordering did not revert. The deeper claim is confirmed: SYA.claim() routes nudgeAmount via a plain IERC20(USDC).safeTransfer(nudge) — the recipient needs no further authorization, so funding-in is genuinely complete.
impact: Fixed. The migration is no longer half-cutover on the SYA funding path.
evidence: side-effects.json fixVerification.fixB_nudgeSplit_BMR-M-01; StableYieldAccumulator.claim() L506-517; forge test test_repointStateAfterScript.
recommendation: No further action for this entry point.
dedupDisposition: PRESERVED (reconciliation record; not a new finding to report — ledger must record fixed status)

title: Old-minter retire guard remains grief-abortable mid-broadcast (require(USDC.balanceOf(OLD)==0))
description: The retire step still asserts require(USDC.balanceOf(OLD_BATCH_MINTER)==0) inside the single broadcast tx, AFTER the irreversible repoint and BPT seed. Any third party can front-run the broadcast with a 1-wei USDC transfer to OLD_BATCH_MINTER to make this require revert. Because broadcast uses --skip-simulation, the revert is not caught pre-flight; the whole tx reverts on-chain (atomic rollback, so no stuck half-state, but the owner-signed Ledger broadcast is wasted and must be retried — repeatedly griefable). The fix diff did not touch this code path. Live OLD USDC balance is 0 at block 25208568, so the guard passes today, but the grief window is unchanged from baseline.
impact: Cheap, repeatable denial-of-service on the owner's cutover broadcast (gas + operational cost). Not a fund-loss path.
evidence: Unchanged in diff ebc2808..912a33d; _retireOld L483-491; broadcast variant uses --skip-simulation (entry-manifest).
recommendation: Replace the equality assert with a defensive sweep (rescue any residual USDC from OLD before/instead of reverting), or gate the assert so a dust balance does not abort the whole cutover (e.g. require balance below a small threshold, or move neutralization to a separate idempotent tx).
dedupDisposition: KEPT (unique root cause; concrete front-run attack vector; QA/Low candidate)

title: Seeded USDC is not asserted against an expected pot delta at the script level
description: The script enforces a USDC floor only inside SeedSwapHelper (minUsdcOut=MIN_USDC_OUT=47.0) and measures usdcOut as a balance delta, but performs no script-level post-condition tying the seeded amount to the intended ~50 USDC target (e.g. require(usdcSeeded within a band of SEED_USDS_TARGET-derived expectation)). A mis-calibrated SEED_USDS_TARGET or stale fork-tuned constants could seed materially more or less than intended without aborting. The fix diff did not address this. Fork-observed seed was 50.418681 USDC (above the 47.0 floor), so it is correct today, but there is no upper bound and no tie to intent.
impact: Spec-deviation / weak outcome guard. A wrong constant over-drains the BPT or under-funds the pot silently within the broad 47.0 floor.
evidence: Unchanged in diff; MIN_USDC_OUT only enforced helper-internally; no require on usdcSeeded vs target.
recommendation: Add a script-level band assertion on usdcSeeded (lower AND upper bound derived from SEED_USDS_TARGET), and require the calibration constants are re-tuned against a fresh fork before broadcast.
dedupDisposition: KEPT (same function as BMR-M-02 but distinct root cause MissingOutcomeAssertion vs UnboundedSwapSlippage, separate mitigation — not a duplicate; QA/Low candidate)
